rows.note: Use this construction for beer or cider served in a pint measure, such as 一品脫啤酒.

example.english: I’d like a pint of beer, please.
example.traditional: 我想要一品脫啤酒，唔該。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 ban2 tyut3 be1 zau2 m4 goi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese unit word for either an imperial or a US pint; add 英制 or 美制 when the distinction matters.

example.english: This bottle contains a pint of juice.
example.jyutping: ne1 zeon1 gwo2 zap1 jau5 jat1 ban2 tyut3
